Name: Multiplayer Mod Limit
Author: weizinai
Description:
[font=Arial][size=6][url=https://github.com/weizinai/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/MultiplayerModLimit/Docs/Readme.md]中文介绍[/url][/size]

[size=6]Introduce[/size]

[size=3]This mod allows you to limit the mods of farmhand. The mod only needs to be installed at the host player, and if the farmhand installs the mod, they will receive a message in the SMAPI console that the mod requirements are not met.[/size]

[size=6]How To Use[/size]

[size=3]Set the [/size][b][u]Allowed Mod List[/u][/b][size=3], [/size][b][u]Required Mod List[/u][/b][size=3] and [/size][b][u]Banned Mod List[/u][/b][size=3] options in [/size][b][u]config.json[/u][/b][size=3] file.[/size]

[size=6]Config[/size]

[size=5]AllowedModList[/size]

[size=3]This option only works if the [/size][b][u]Limit Mode[/u][/b][size=3] is [/size][b][u]White List Mode[/u][/b][size=3]. The mods in this option are the ones that are allowed to be installed.[/size]

[/font][code]﻿"AllowedModList":
{
"Default":
[
"ModUniqueId1"
]
"TestName1":
[
"ModUniqueId2",
"ModUniqueId3"
],
"TestName2":
[
"ModUniqueId4",
"ModUniqueId5"
]
}
[/code][font=Arial]
[size=5]RequiredModList[/size]

[size=3]This option works when the [/size][b][u]Limit Mode[/u][/b][size=3] is [/size][b][u]White List Mode[/u][/b][size=3] and [/size][b][u]Black List Mode[/u][/b][size=3]. The mods in this option are the ones that must be installed.[/size]

[/font][code]"RequiredModList":
{
"Default":
[
"ModUniqueId1"
]
"TestName1":
[
"ModUniqueId2",
"ModUniqueId3"
],
"TestName2":
[
"ModUniqueId4",
"ModUniqueId5"
]
}
[/code][font=Arial]
[size=5]BannedModList[/size]

[size=3]This option only works if the [/size][b][u]Limit Mode[/u][/b][size=3] is [/size][b][u]Black List Mode[/u][/b][size=3]. The mods in this option are the ones that are forbidden to install.[/size]

[/font][code]"BannedModList":
{
"Default":
[
"ModUniqueId1"
]
"TestName1":
[
"ModUniqueId2",
"ModUniqueId3"
],
"TestName2":
[
"ModUniqueId4",
"ModUniqueId5"
]
}
[/code][font=Arial]
